title: Columbia Men's Titanium Bugalution GTX Cold Winter Boot
review: I love these boots. They are lightweight and very comfortable. They are well made and I think they will serve me well for years. What really impressed me was the customer service from the vendor. The boots came in with one of those security tags still stuck on the laces. It was one of the tags that spill ink if not removed with the tool. I called the store and they were very apologetic. They instantly emailed me a prepaid UPS label to return the boots so they could remove the tag off the lace and send them back to me. In addition, without me requesting it, they told me they would take $25 off the boots. Now that is caring about how the customer thinks about you. I figured that I would have to wait for the credit and maybe it would show up in a couple of weeks, but no, I got an email from Amazon the next day telling me that Amazing Socks had issued a credit. I got the boots back, and found an excellent vendor. Thanks Amazon!
